tests: credential-scrub reports error, never clean, when git config cannot answer: a global credential.helper probed from inside a repository whose own config is malformed

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/gates/credentials.ts decides three credential-scrub probes (git-global-config, git-system-config, git-resolved-config) from the exit code of `git config [--scope] --get-all credential.helper`, so red-witness rule (f) binds this witness. The capture records, on git 2.43.0 and on the Ubuntu 22.04 git 2.34.1, the two answers of the documented contract (0 with the value, 1 for not set) and the third outcome the probes used to fold into not set: exit 128 with `fatal: bad config line N in file .git/config` when the directory the read runs in is a repository whose own config git cannot parse, while the global file names a helper that a child in a healthy worktree resolves (resolved-helper-healthy-worktree, exit 0, `store`). The named test reproduces both live against the capture before calling the probes, and asserts both probe rows are error, carrying git's own line. The two members are the two probe sites: member 0 folds the scoped probes' non-answer back into clean, member 1 does the same to the no-scope probe; each alone turns one asserted error row back into clean.
